programs.name: 2-Step Prime Challenge (Forex)
programs.consistency_rule: None on the Bi-Weekly or Monthly payout cycles; 40% consistency score (best day / total profit) on the On-Demand cycle (funded stage)
programs.profit_split: 80% (Bi-Weekly or On-Demand cycle) or 95% (Monthly cycle, +20% on the fee); cycle chosen at purchase and cannot be changed
programs.payout_frequency: Bi-weekly (every 14 days) by default; Monthly or On-Demand chosen at purchase. Requests processed within 1 hour after an account review of up to 24 business hours
programs.payout_rules_note: Bi-weekly: at least 3 profitable days (each >= 0.5% of initial balance) in 14 days. Monthly: 7 profitable days in 30 days. On-Demand: 40% consistency and at least 2% total profit. Minimum payout $50 (bank wire/crypto) or $500 (Rise), excluding the firm's share. 2.5% processing fee on all methods (min $25 bank/Rise, $5 crypto). Mandatory KYC video interview before the first payout. Challenge fee refunded 100% with the 4th successful payout from the same account (Forex only). Funded stage: 2% max risk per trade idea and stop loss mandatory on every trade.
programs.notes: Price $319 is for $50K, MT5, Bi-Weekly @80% (site default). Same 50K costs $339 with On-Demand and $383 with Monthly @95%; cTrader +$20; Swap-free and EA add-ons +10% each. Targets 8% ($4,000) Phase 1 and 5% ($2,500) Phase 2; minimum 3 trading days per phase. Daily loss 5% of previous day's closing balance (4% / 8% max on $200K). Leverage 50x. News trading and weekend holding allowed in both phases. Inactivity: 30 days.

programs.name: 1-Step Prime Challenge (Forex)
programs.consistency_rule: None on the Bi-Weekly or Monthly payout cycles; 40% on the On-Demand cycle (funded stage)
programs.profit_split: 80% (Bi-Weekly or On-Demand) or 95% (Monthly, +20% on the fee)
programs.payout_frequency: Bi-weekly by default; Monthly or On-Demand chosen at purchase
programs.payout_rules_note: Same payout policy as 2-Step Prime: profitable-day requirements per cycle, $50 minimum (bank/crypto) or $500 (Rise), 2.5% fee, KYC interview before first payout, fee refunded with the 4th payout, 2% max risk per trade idea and mandatory stop loss in the funded stage.
programs.notes: Price $329 for $50K, MT5, Bi-Weekly @80%; $349 On-Demand, $395 Monthly @95%. Target 10%, daily loss 3% of previous day's closing balance, max loss 6% static, 50x leverage, min 2 trading days. News and weekend holding allowed. Other forex plans: 2-Step Pro ($384 for 50K, 100x leverage, 5%/10%, news and weekend holding restricted on funded accounts, 20-lot max position on 50K) and Direct (no evaluation, 7% EOD trailing max loss, 20% consistency).

programs.name: 1-Step Prime Challenge (Futures)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (4% of initial balance on 25K/50K; trails highest end-of-day balance and locks at the starting balance once the account is +4%)
programs.consistency_rule: 40% in the challenge (needed to pass); 35% in the funded account (needed for each payout)
programs.payout_frequency: weekly (every 7 calendar days after the first trade following the previous payout); processed within 1 hour after review
programs.payout_rules_note: At least 5 profitable days (non-consecutive) of >= $150 each on 50K before every payout. Minimum payout $500 on 50K. Payout caps on 50K: $1,500 (1st), $2,000 (2nd), $2,500 (3rd), $3,000 (4th onwards). After a payout the max loss limit resets to the starting balance. 2.5% processing fee. Funded stage: 2% max risk per trade idea (1% on DX Futures) and stop loss mandatory. Current 'Limited Deal' on the futures page: $0 activation and challenge fee refunded with the first four payouts.
programs.notes: Hola Prime's futures page says 'no monthly subscriptions', while its help center describes a monthly subscription; check at checkout.

news_trading: Restricted by plan: allowed in all challenges and on Forex Prime and Futures funded accounts; on Forex 2-Step Pro and Forex Direct funded accounts, no opening, closing or modifying trades from 5 minutes before to 5 minutes after high-impact news
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: third-party EAs and bots only on MT5 with the paid EA add-on (+10%); not allowed on cTrader, Match-Trader, TradeLocker or Direct accounts; the EA strategy must be declared; passing with an EA and then trading manually (or the reverse) is prohibited. Futures rules page lists EAs as 'Restricted'
copy_trading: Restricted: only between Hola Prime accounts owned by the same person. Forex funded accounts: maximum one master and one copier account (accounts bought on or after 15 Sep 2026). Futures: own accounts only, and the lead account must have the lowest position limit. Copying from other prop firms or other people is prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Forex: overnight allowed on all accounts; weekend holding allowed on Prime challenges and Prime funded accounts, not on 2-Step Pro or Direct funded accounts (close before 15:45 EST Friday). Futures: no overnight or weekend holding; close by 3:30 PM CT daily
restricted_countries_note: Restricted: Afghanistan, Belarus, Burundi, Central African Republic, China, Cuba, North Korea, DR Congo, Eritrea, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Haiti, Hong Kong, India, Iran, Iraq, Laos, Libya, Mali, Moldova, Myanmar, Nicaragua, Oman, Pakistan, Russia, Somalia, Syria, Tunisia, Ukraine, Vietnam, Yemen, Zimbabwe. US clients accepted (forex: Match-Trader and TradeLocker only, no MT5/cTrader). 11 countries (e.g. Nigeria, Malaysia, Indonesia, Israel) are capped at $90K forex allocation.
path_to_live: Futures only: invite-only Hola Prime Live Account for traders with at least 10 payouts totalling $50,000+ from a sim-funded account. Up to 15% of the account size moves over as starting equity ($7,500 for 50K); no daily or max loss limits; 90% split with daily rewards; max 4/40 contracts on 50K; one live account per trader. No live route published for forex

current_public_promo.applies_to: All forex accounts, new users only (not futures)

affiliate_program.commission: Flat 30% of the first order of each new referred trader only; repeat purchases earn nothing; no tiers
affiliate_program.notes: Sign up from the trader dashboard; KYC and a signed Affiliate Agreement required, then approval. Monthly payouts (30-day cycle), $100 minimum, paid in USD/EUR/GBP/USDT. Says it 'supports affiliates from over 170+ countries'. Serbia: not stated explicitly for affiliates; Serbia is not on the trader restricted-country list. No purchase or trading experience required.

pros: Offers both forex/CFD (MT5, cTrader, Match-Trader, TradeLocker) and CME futures (Tradovate, NinjaTrader, WealthCharts) from one account
Forex Prime challenges use a static max loss (10% on 2-Step, 6% on 1-Step) and allow news trading and weekend holding
Forex challenge fee is refunded with the 4th payout; payouts are processed within 1 hour once the review (up to 24 business hours) is done
Futures 1-Step Prime has no daily loss limit, a 90% split and weekly payouts; a published invite-only live-capital route exists for futures
cons: Trustpilot removed about 1,300 fake reviews from its profile in March 2025; the firm only launched in late 2024
Funded accounts have a 2% max risk per trade idea with a mandatory stop loss; the forex split is 80% unless you pay 20% more for the monthly 95% cycle
Futures payouts are capped ($1,500 first payout on 50K) and need 5 profitable days of $150+ plus a 35% consistency score each time
Futures billing is described as a monthly subscription in the help center but as 'no monthly subscriptions' on the landing page
Terms include a non-disparagement clause and say support correspondence may not be shared publicly without consent
best_for: Traders who want forex/CFD and CME futures challenges under one firm, with static-drawdown forex evaluations and weekly 90% futures payouts, and who accept a 2% per-trade risk cap on funded accounts.
